title: "If the accident will" - Paul Dean's (work)blog
subtitle: Hello! I’m Paul Dean, a writer, games designer and narrative designer, journalist and speaker. I have a Patreon which funds much of the independent work you read here. I’m known for features such as the hugely successful A Year in Stardew Valley and On Poverty, for my writing on video games like Pacific Drive or Maia, or on a host of tabletop games that include Paranoia, Feng Shui 2 and Magical Kitties Save the Day. posts.title: On Hiking
posts.description: Once again, taken from my Patreon , which has much more work. There is a bear in the bushes. This isn’t really the ideal time for a bear in the bushes, because it’s past six in the evening, a hot and heavy sun the colour of liquid gold is losing its grip on the perfect sky and it’s not clear to me how strong the evening light will be once it falls behind the peak. posts.title: Painting my dreams: Caspar David Friedrich
posts.description: paullicino : A hundred and eighty years before I even existed, a man had started painting my dreams. Somehow, he’d looked into the future and seen inside my head, seen the enormous landscapes that filled my sleep, captured the grasslands and forests and moonlight and towering windows.
